See [[#Patches|Patches]] for a download link. | Windows, OS X}} }} ==Essential improvements== ===Patches=== {{ii}} There are 8 patches in total, but only the last three are required. {{ii}} The Steam version is already patched. {{ii}} The retail GOTY edition is patched to version 1.6. * [https://community.pcgamingwiki.com/files/file/373-call-of-duty-4-modern-warfare-windows-patch/ v1.6 patch] (includes the Variety Pack) * [https://community.pcgamingwiki.com/files/file/375-call-of-duty-4-modern-warfare-windows-patch/ v1.6 to v1.7 patch (Windows)] * [https://community.pcgamingwiki.com/files/file/377-call-of-duty-4-modern-warfare-os-x-patch/ v1.7 patch (OS X)] * [http://www.activision.com/cdn/downloads/iw3mp.exe Official security fix for 1.7]{{Refurl|url=https://support.activision.com/call-of-duty-4--modern-warfare/articles/call-of-duty-4-modern-warfare-pc-security-update|title=Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare PC Security Update|date=2022-11-21}} ===[https://cod4x.ovh/t/releases/24 CoD4X Mod]=== {{ii}} A client and server modification for multiplayer that adds enhanced functionality and security to servers, bug fixes, and its own [http://cod4master.cod4x.ovh/ server list]. ===[https://gitea.com/JerryALT/iw3sp_mod/releases/latest IW3SP-MOD]=== {{ii}} A singleplayer client that adds enhanced functionality, such as achievements from Xbox 360 version, controller/gamepad support with aim assist, increased asset limits and more. {{ii}} If retaining the Steam playtime is desired, enter "{{folder|{{p|game}}}}\Call of Duty 4\iw3sp_mod.exe" %command% in the launch options. {{++}} Can be launch without Steam via {{code|iw3sp_mod.exe}}. ===PunkBuster=== {{ii}} To play on protected servers, multiplayer requires a [[PunkBuster]] update which is no longer hosted on EvenBalance's website. Obtainable [https://github.com/promod/CoD-PunkBuster-Files here], [http://www.opferlamm-clan.de/wbb2/thread.php?postid=152764#post152764 here], or [https://mega.nz/file/RQkjgQjb#HtPv4I9153tk4-Xej5C4vFSp4lX-6XjIwEICMPE-vII here]. {{ii}} By not updating PunkBuster, Steam will ask every time when trying to play if it is allowed to make changes, by selecting No or by closing the pop-up, the PunkBuster pop-up can be skipped.{{Refcheck|user=Faust8|date=2025-04-09|comment=}} ===Skip intro videos=== {{Fixbox|description=Use the seta com_introplayed "1" [[Glossary:Command line arguments|command line argument]]|ref={{Refcheck|user=Tecc|date=2022-05-20}}}} {{Fixbox|description=Change seta com_introplayed from 0 to 1 in {{Fixbox|description=Enable stereo mix|ref={{cn|date=September 2016}}|fix= * Plug in a microphone. Alternatively: # Go to Control Panel. # Open Sound settings. # Click the recording tab. # Enable stereo mix (right clicking and selecting "Show disabled devices" might be needed for it to be visible). '''Notes''' {{ii}} On Windows 11 in the same tab, enable "Microphone" to achieve the same result if "Stereo Mix" doesn't appear, it seems to have been renamed. It does not matter if a microphone is not plugged in. }} ===Game sound is replaced with microphone input=== {{Fixbox|description=Disable recording device (Windows)|ref={{cn|date=2024-07-14}}|fix= # From Control Panel, open the Sound menu. # Under the Recording tab, disable any input devices. }} ===Stuttering issues with high-end graphics cards=== {{ii}} The game randomly stutters (not related to FPS) with higher-end graphics cards (e.g. Nvidia GeForce GTX 680 and above). {{Fixbox|description=Enable "Dual Video Cards" option in Graphics settings|ref={{Refcheck|user=Blackbird|date=2019-11-23|comment=Tested with GTX 980 on W10 1909}}}} ===Stuttering and sudden frame drops on Nvidia GPUs=== {{Fixbox|description=Disable frame rate limiter in Nvidia Control Panel|ref={{cn|date=2024-07-14}}|fix= '''Notes''' {{ii}} If Frame Limiter is enabled, it will cause random stutters and FPS drops to occur during gameplay. Either disable the frame limiter for the game only by changing its program settings and setting the frame limiter option to off, or disable the limiter entirely in the global settings. }} {{Fixbox|description=Disable Fast sync in Nvidia Control Panel|ref={{cn|date=2024-07-14}}|fix= '''Notes''' {{ii}} If Fast Sync is enabled, it will cause periodic frametime stutters and FPS drops. }} ===Ambient occlusion issues on Nvidia GPUs=== {{Image|Call Of Duty 4 Modern Warfare Ambient Occlusion ON.jpg|Ambient Occlusion set to Performance.}} {{Image|Call Of Duty 4 Modern Warfare Ambient Occlusion OFF.jpg|Ambient Occlusion set to off.}} {{Fixbox|description=Disable Ambient Occlusion inside NVIDIA Control Panel|fix= {{ii}} {{file|iw3sp.exe}} is for singleplayer, {{file|iw3mp.exe}} is for multiplayer. # Open the Nvidia Control Panel. # Go to 3D Settings, Manage 3D settings, Program Settings. # Click Add, Browse and select {{file|iw3sp.exe}} or {{file|iw3mp.exe}} inside {{folder|{{p|game}}}}. # Set Ambient Occlusion to Off. }} ==="Unable to initialize PunkBuster.
